title: Venetian Bronze Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Venetian Bronze, 30-inch towel bar for bathroom use with wall mount, straight bar design, and traditional style, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. This wall-mounted towel bar (also searched as towel rack, towel holder, towel rail) is crafted from solid brass with concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished appearance. Size: 30 inches / 30-inch; center-to-center 30 in; bar diameter 0.75 in. Wall mount installation uses space efficiently and includes mounting plates and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4). Weight capacity 10 lb.  and covered by a Limited Lifetime Warranty. Ideal for matching Carolina collection and traditional bathroom hardware / classic bath accessories. Allied Brass Carolina.
